title: Resveratrol induces ferroptosis to repress malignant progression of lung cancer cells.
snippet: Lung cancer (LC) is a highly lethal malignancy arising from tracheobronchial mucosal or glandular epithelium, responsible for ~18% of global cancer mortality, with poor long‑term patient survival.
